design: one shared 2000 x 30000 multinomial count matrix (default_rng(42)) for every seed run, model and configuration; counts zeroed on rows invalid in that seed run; the 0% baseline of the run uses the same restricted counts
statistic: D(m,b) = mean over the 10 mask seeds of [masked AUC - 0% AUC]; contrast C(b) = D(BN,b) - D(model,b); positive = the BN degrades less
